title: Great walking tour!
text: Antonio was a wonderful guide! Very knowledgeable and personable. We enjoyed it very much. Granada is a beautiful city!!
author: Pedro M

title: Great tour with lots of historical background
text: Rasha provided us with a lot of interesting information, stories and legends on our tour. She walked with us through Granada at almost 40 degrees and responded to our wishes and needs. She was very well prepared and showed us old photographs and maps to explain the historical background. Overall highly recommended. It was very entertaining.
author: Benetteto

title: Excellent tour
text: Great Tour,  guide was pleasant and knowledgeable. She did great keeping kids in group engaged and participating.
author: Carlos_L

title: Brilliant walking tour
text: Great walking tour.  Very knowledgeable guide & we saw so much of Granada.  We both loved it.  She gave us a great tip to take our passport to Alhambra, without this we would not have known and would not have got entry.
author: Helen_D

title: Very good tour
text: Very good tour, particularly since it was crowded. Our guide helped navigate us through and was quite witty.
author: Whitney_H

title: Granada Tour
text: Our tour guide was exceptionally knowledgeable and informative, making the experience truly enjoyable. She answered all my questions with patience and depth, demonstrating her expertise and passion for the history of Granada. Her engaging approach and willingness to share insights made the tour both educational and memorable. I truly appreciate her dedication and highly recommend her to anyone looking for an enriching experience!
author: Ana_L

title: Excellent
text: We did the visit with Rasha and it was excellent. She was very knowledgeable, punctual and friendly, we really enjoyed it!
